summary: Kiosk TV P1 frontend features fully verified via Playwright. All 7 requested scenarios PASSED — AUTO mode (data-mode=auto, pause btn, badge 'Auto · Hari Ini 60 detik'), toggle to Bulanan (month-view + badge 'Auto · Bulanan 30 detik'), PAUSE (badge 'Auto · Dijeda', btn text 'Lanjut' ↔ 'Jeda'), STATIC mode (data-mode=static, always today-view, no toggle, no pause), MANUAL mode (data-mode=manual, toggle present, no pause, no auto-badge, toggling works), invalid token displays 'Token tidak valid.', and Admin /dasbor/admin → tab 'Kiosk TV' shows dual URLs kiosk-url-auto (contains &mode=auto) & kiosk-url-static (contains &mode=static) with copy/regen/revoke buttons.

Not part of P1 scope but worth surfacing — kiosk still functions correctly since it also refreshes via load() effect on ok. Consider guarding useBookingSocket when no auth cookie present to keep kiosk console clean.
